_comment: Reference GGUFs for packages whose own GGUF llama.cpp cannot load. Keyed by the checkpoint the package serves (model.json origins.checkpoint repository@revision + llm_config.json gguf): the gates' llama-server loads `reference` instead (fetched and sha256-checked by reference_model.py), which must hold the same tensors in a layout mainline llama.cpp reads, published by the checkpoint's own publisher at the same revision. llamacpp_min: the oldest lemonade-sdk/llamacpp-rocm release that serves it correctly (older builds give wrong output, not an error). Never a different quantization or checkpoint: that would be an easier oracle.
